about: Round 4 (Claude, 2026-11-06, on Kai's note: 'the choruses are still cutting on the snare'). Measured: chorus 1 (beat 96), chorus 2 (172), the break (196) and the final chorus (291) all start on a snare beat, so every 2-beat chorus cut sat on the snare. Each of those sections now starts one beat later, on the kick, with its cut pattern unchanged. Everything else is round 3.
